ModMetaData.name: More xenotypes and multicultural factions
ModMetaData.author: GrillMaster
ModMetaData.description:
A simple mod to increase xenohuman variety in-game.
This mod adds both additional xenotypes and germline xenohumans to the game, including the nature-loving Artemid, the worker drone Proles, and the friendly dog-like Gwennin. It also adds multicultural factions into the game that have a variety of existing and new xenotypes in them.
